title: I do. Not 200 texts.
request: Create ONE 25-second vertical TikTok video for Envitefy.com, funny stylish wedding-planning ad with realistic people. 0–7: engaged couple at dinner, buzzing questions Where’s the venue? What time is the ceremony? How do I RSVP? One says We said ‘I do’—not ‘I’ll answer 200 texts.’ 7–18: share elegant real wedding invitation, guests open details, RSVP and add calendar. Caption Wedding details. RSVPs. Calendar reminders. All together. 18–25: clink glasses, Now… the seating chart. Lower glasses, music stops. End Less coordinating. More celebrating. Supplied logo, real interface, quick cuts, playful music, readable captions.

shots.chaos: Create exactly 10 seconds VERTICAL 9:16 photorealistic LIVE ACTION comedy with continuous realistic human movement and natural synchronized English dialogue. Fresh fictional engaged couple early thirties: South Asian woman with long dark wavy hair, rose satin blouse, small gold hoop earrings; East Asian man with short textured black hair, forest-green knit polo. Seated SIDE BY SIDE at intimate walnut restaurant dinner table, caramel leather banquette, cream plaster walls, warm candlelight, elegant dinner plates, two half-filled stemmed wine glasses, black phones lying separately on table. Medium two-shot showing both faces in upper-middle and hands/table below. [0–0.7 seconds] They try to take a bite, both phones vibrate loudly. [0.7–1.5] Quick close cut to phones BUZZING and rattling lightly on wood, screens dark/out of focus with NO legible text. [1.5–2.2] Cut back to identical couple, man rolls eyes at another buzz. [2.2–6.6] Woman looks directly into camera with perfectly dry amused exhaustion and says EXACTLY: 'We said I do, not I’ll answer two hundred texts.' Deliver fluently, conversationally, naturally, never rushed, clean precise lipsync. Man silently reacts. [6.6–7] Small deadpan beat. [7–10] Same framing, woman picks up her own black phone with left hand, taps once with right index finger to share their wedding invitation, then both smile with relief. Phone display faces her, back faces camera. Same two people and table throughout. No narrator, extra words, laughter track or music. Natural restaurant room tone, realistic phone vibrations, clear woman dialogue. No generated captions, letters, logos, borders, or UI. Not stills, not animation. Natural hands with five fingers and correct object contact.
